evals.name: folder-with-spaces
evals.prompt: Convert all the iPhone photos in C:\Users\me\Pictures\iCloud Photos\Trip 2026 to JPEG. Keep the originals but get them out of the way.
evals.expected_output: Runs the bundled convert_heic.py on the quoted path with --archive-originals and reports the script's own converted/skipped/failed summary.

assertions.text: runs the bundled scripts/convert_heic.py rather than writing a new converter
quotes the path that contains spaces
uses --archive-originals rather than deleting the .heic files
reports the script's summary of converted, skipped and failed files

evals.name: pip-fails-offline
evals.prompt: Convert photo.heic to jpg. (When the script runs, pip install pillow-heif fails: no network.)
evals.expected_output: Reports the pip error and stops; does not hand-roll a converter.

assertions.text: reports that the dependency install failed and why
does not fall back to a hand-written conversion script or another library

evals.name: rerun-idempotent
evals.prompt: I ran the HEIC conversion yesterday on ~/Photos/export and added 12 new .heic files today. Convert again.
evals.expected_output: Re-runs the script on the folder without --overwrite so only the 12 new files convert, and reports the skip count.

assertions.text: re-runs the bundled script on the same folder
explains that already-converted files are skipped
